The procedure record indicates that water should be added to the acid. However, this is extremely dangerous - the correct and safe procedure is to add acid to water, never water to acid. Adding water to concentrated sulfuric acid causes a violent exothermic reaction that can cause the acid to boil and splatter.

I will run this step with the safe value of "acid into water":
judge_text:
